title: Accounting Analytics / Data Visualizing
description: This course provides an introduction, to, and hands-on experience with, data management, accounting analytics, and data visualization using Alteryx Designer and Tableau Desktop. By learning both practical software tools and the principles of data management and data visualization, you’ll be better prepared to leverage data to provide insights into important accounting, auditing, and taxation problems.
prerequisites: ACC 424 with a grade of B or better, or if taking ACC 434 and 424 during the same semester the student’s overall GPA in Gatton courses must be 3.2 or greater at the start of the semester the course is taken, or Approval by the Director of the Von Allmen School of Accountancy
